sources.title: Image Captioning - Colab
sources.snippet: Our image captioning architecture consists of three models: A CNN: used to extract the image features A TransformerEncoder: The extracted image features are then passed to a Transformer based encoder that generates a new representation of the inputs A TransformerDecoder: This model takes the encoder output and the text data (sequences) as inputs and tries to learn to generate the caption.

sources.title: Image captioning · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Image captioning Image captioning is the task of predicting a caption for a given image. Common real world applications of it include aiding visually impaired people that can help them navigate through different situations. Therefore, image captioning helps to improve content accessibility for people by describing images to them.
